scrape() rejects loopback addresses by default SSRF policy

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

do {
    let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}")
    let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
    let url = "http://127.0.0.1:9/"
    _ = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
